subject: Request: compressing demo window to accommodate travel and stakeholder availability

Subject: Request: compressing demo window to accommodate travel and stakeholder availability

Hi Alex —

Quick note ahead of our walkthrough later this week. One of our SEs (Karthik) is boarding a flight right after the original 60-minute slot, and your VP mentioned a tight window for a few execs on Friday. To avoid pulling people for the whole hour, can we compress the demo into a 25–30 minute focused session that covers:

- 5m: quick intros + objectives
- 15–18m: core demo (latency/cost controls, routing, Dedicated options)
- 5–7m: next steps + Qs + action items

Attached is a pared-down agenda (agenda_compact.pdf). If the execs need deeper technical detail, Karthik and I can do a separate 30-min technical deep-dive next week.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Fri 2026-05-29 15:00–15:30
- Fri 2026-05-29 10:30–11:00 (earlier option)

If those don't work, please suggest a 30-min window and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: agenda_compact.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Thanks, Soojin.

A compressed session sounds good — our execs only have a 30-minute block starting at 15:00 PDT on Friday and they want to see the high-level impact on throughput and predictable latency. If Karthik can hit latency/SLOs and cost controls in ~15 minutes, that should be perfect.

Please lock 15:00–15:30 PDT and we'll keep the core stakeholders on that call. Ops included in CC for scheduling.
